reference_spoken: First John chapter one, verse nine.
verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verse_spoken: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins,
and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning with an honest heart.
You know every word I have spoken and every thought I have hidden.
I confess the ways I have fallen short, and I ask you to forgive me.
Thank you that your mercy is greater than my mistakes.
Wash me clean, and lift the weight of guilt and shame from my shoulders.
Help me to forgive those who have hurt me, as you have forgiven me.
Where bitterness has taken root, plant your peace and your love instead.
Teach me to walk in your grace today, free and unafraid.
Let everyone praying with me feel your forgiveness and a fresh beginning.
